scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w client" "npm run dev -w server"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p shared/tsconfig.json && tsc -p server/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p client/tsconfig.json && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json && tsc -p desktop/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.host: npm run build && npm run start -w server
scripts.desktop: npm run build && npm run desktop-stage && tsx scripts/run-desktop.ts
scripts.dist-desktop: npm run build && npm run desktop-stage && electron-builder --config desktop/builder.json
